query:
INSERT INTO exercise_repositories (
    id,
    course_id,
    exam_id,
    url,
    branch,
    deploy_key,
    public_key,
    status,
    error_message,
    last_synced_at
  )
SELECT uuid_generate_v5($1, id::text),
  CASE
    WHEN course_id IS NOT NULL THEN $1
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN exam_id IS NOT NULL THEN $1
  END,
  url,
  branch,
  deploy_key,
  public_key,
  status,
  error_message,
  last_synced_at
FROM exercise_repositories
WHERE (
    course_id = $2
    OR exam_id = $2
  )
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;
